definitions: A visual representation or symbol that has been processed or altered by a filter, often to highlight specific features, remove unwanted elements, or apply a particular style.
In user interfaces, an icon that indicates a filter is currently active or has been applied to a set of data or content.
examples: The filtered icon on the dashboard showed only unread messages.
She clicked the filtered icon to view images from last year.
The software displayed a filtered icon for each category of documents.
